summary: A single-threaded Observable<T> with sink, map, remove_duplicates, combine_latest for two observables and cancel-on-drop subscriptions covers the CurrentValueSubject and @Published cases. A PassthroughSubject with sink, map and filter covers the send-only subject. Other operators, convenience publishers, schedulers, back pressure and threading are missing.

features.apple: Publisher, Publishers (map, filter, merge, combineLatest, debounce...)
features.note: map, remove_duplicates, filter and combine_latest (two observables); no merge, debounce, flatMap or publisher-typed operator chains
cancel on drop and store(in:) bag

features.apple: Future, Just, Deferred, Empty, Fail, Record
features.note: none; Observable::new is the nearest to Just

features.apple: Subscriber, Subscribers, AnySubscriber, Subscription, Subscriptions, back pressure
features.note: sink/subscribe closures only; no Demand, no completion, no failure type
CurrentValueSubject via Observable; PassthroughSubject with send, sink, map and filter; no send(completion:) and no failure type
GCD queues exist, but no receive(on:)/subscribe(on:) integration; Observable is Rc and single-threaded
sources exist with callbacks; none are exposed as publishers
no objectWillChange aggregate; one Observable per property
Codable-style coding exists, no publisher decode operator
subscribe(old,new), set returns changed, unsubscribe token

gaps: merge, flatMap and the other operators beyond map, filter and combineLatest (two observables)
Completion and failure types, Demand/back pressure
Future, Just, Empty and Fail publishers; send(completion:) on subjects
